title: Training Computer Use Agents to Assess the Usability of Graphical User Interfaces
abstract: arXiv:2604.26020v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent HCI research leverages AI agents to assess graphical user interfaces (GUIs) usability, but current agents still struggle. Computer use agents (CUAs) that are used in these assessments are predominantly developed using objective task trajectories with verifiable outcomes and lack an operationalized definition of usability and necessary training data. This work presents a novel training objective that operationalizes usability to fine-tune CUAs to assess GUI usability through relative comparisons between interface variants. We apply our method to CUA models using a large-scale dataset of fully interactive UIs paired with usability labels mixed with human preferences.Two empirical evaluations across real and synthetic GUIs show that our method i) improved relative usability assessment accuracy across three off-the-shelf CUA models, ii) enabled our best model to outperform proprietary baselines, and iii) produced grounded us

translated_title: 训练计算机使用智能体来评估图形用户界面的可用性
translated_abstract: 近期的人机交互（HCI）研究利用AI智能体来评估图形用户界面（GUI）的可用性，但当前的智能体仍然表现不佳。用于这些评估的计算机使用智能体（CUA）主要是通过具有可验证结果的客观任务轨迹开发的，缺乏可用性的可操作化定义和必要的训练数据。本工作提出了一种新颖的训练目标，将可用性进行可操作化定义，以微调CUA通过界面变体之间的相对比较来评估GUI的可用性。我们使用一个大规模的全交互式UI数据集（配有混合了人类偏好的可用性标签）将该应用于CUA模型。在真实和合成GUI上的两项实证评估表明，我们的方法：i）提升了三个现成CUA模型的相对可用性评估准确性；ii）使我们的最佳模型超越了专有基线模型；iii）产生了有据可依的可用性评估结果。
tldr: 提出一种将可用性可操作化的新型训练目标，通过界面变体间的相对比较来微调计算机使用智能体（CUA），显著提升了GUI可用性评估的准确性，并使最佳模型超越了专有基线。
en_tdlr: Proposes a novel training objective that operationalizes usability to fine-tune computer use agents (CUAs) for assessing GUI usability through relative comparisons between interface variants, improving assessment accuracy and enabling the best model to outperform proprietary baselines.
